newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in moderate trade on Monday with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said.

"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. There's no fresh news or (U.S.) economic indicators coming out tonight, but some traders were waiting for possible direction from Tuesday's issue of the (U.S.) housing starts figures," a local dealer said.
"But I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8, nine-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent.
